label: Chapter 1
title: The Minister’s Visit

png.title: Persona Non Grata
png.text: Ombrazia declares you unwelcome, with compliments. Your farewell is a stamped form in an order nobody can document.

replaced.title: Replaced by Capital
replaced.text: HQ goodwill has reached zero. Capital recalls you and appoints a replacement. Please leave the office keys; your successor will need the same drawer of unsolved problems.

cancelled.title: Ministerial Visit Cancelled
cancelled.text: Arrival day has come, but essential arrangements are still unconfirmed. The Minister cancels the visit. Capital describes this as a scheduling adjustment. Your career receives one too.

retired.title: Quietly Retired to Brussels
retired.text: The Capital has lost confidence. You are given a window office overlooking another window.

ambassador.title: The Ambassador Returns and Takes Credit
ambassador.text: Everything worked. The Ambassador reappears tanned, shakes the Minister's hand and thanks 'the team'.

promoted.title: Promoted Sideways
promoted.text: The Minister notices nothing, which is the highest compliment. You are promoted to a post with a longer title and the same desk.

openingLog: The Ambassador is absent. You are the Deputy, now acting head of mission. Plan your first morning.

clearance.label: Note verbale to the Foreign Ministry
clearance.result: The note verbale is delivered and receives a reference number. A reference number is not an answer, but it is filed like one.

clearance.label: Overflight and landing form, correct version
clearance.result: Protocol accepts the landing form in the version in force and initials every page except the one that matters.

clearance.label: Protocol's stamped confirmation
clearance.result: Director Ndao's office stamps the confirmation, for a small fee. The stamp is the right stamp and is kept under glass.

lounge.label: Provisional lounge reservation
lounge.result: The airport enters a provisional hold for the Minister. 'Provisional' is underlined twice.

lounge.label: Lounge deposit paid
lounge.result: The deposit is paid and a receipt issued in triplicate. The lounge is confirmed, subject to the guest list.

lounge.label: Final guest list accepted
lounge.result: The airport accepts forty-one names for a lounge of twelve and describes it as a reception.

programme.label: First draft programme to Capital
programme.result: The first draft reaches Capital, which acknowledges receipt and reserves its position.

programme.label: Capital's amendments absorbed
programme.result: Capital's eleven amendments are absorbed. Nine of them contradict the other two.

programme.label: Host agreement on the programme
programme.result: The Ministry agrees the programme, subject to the programme.

programme.label: Final printed programme
programme.result: The programme is printed, bound and approved by both sides. It is dated Day 15 and wrong only in the minor details.

security.label: Advance team request
security.result: The advance team request is filed. The Security Desk acknowledges it with a request for the advance team.

security.label: Route reconnaissance
security.result: The route is driven twice, once in each direction. Both directions are recorded as satisfactory.

security.label: Motorcade and escort confirmed
security.result: Vehicles and escort are confirmed in writing. The vehicles are described as 'available in principle'.

setbacks.text: Capital moves the Minister's arrival forward by one hour and forty minutes.

targets.label: Host agreement on the new arrival time
Motorcade and escort for the new arrival time

setbacks.text: Protocol supersedes the landing form with version 7.3.
The Minister's delegation has grown by six.

targets.label: Guest list for the enlarged delegation
Final printed programme, with annex F

setbacks.text: The city closes the motorcade route for a parade.
